## Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform RN — page last updated ~June 29, 2026
### GOVERNANCE/SECURITY (net-new surfaces beyond 2026-07-06 report):
- AI security findings + posture-management summaries — GA. Security tab/dashboard:
  "Top security findings" widget, AI risks by severity (vuln/misconfig/toxic combos,
  attack-exposure score), AI threats (real-time), Agents with excessive permissions
  (least-privilege), Compliance widget. Security Command Center findings surfaced in tab.
  Docs: /gemini-enterprise-agent-platform/govern/view-security-findings
- Model Armor on Agent Gateway — GA. Content-security guardrails on prompts/responses
  through the gateway; blocks/redacts or inspect+log; mitigates prompt injection,
  jailbreak, harmful content, data leakage. Docs: /govern/configure-model-armor
- Agent Observability — GA. Perf/behavior/health visibility for deployed agents + MCP
  servers in mgmt workflow; OpenTelemetry tracing ON by default for new ADK agents on Agent Engine.

### Preview / already reported (NOT net-new):
- Semantic Governance Policies (SGP) + SGP engine — Preview (reported 2026-07-06).
- Agents API / Managed Agents, Agent Gateway, Agent Registry, Agent Identity (reported 2026-07-06).
- Supervised fine-tuning for gemini-3.1-flash-lite / gemini-3.5-flash — Preview [model, below bar].
- Multiple pending orders GA (up to 7) [quota, below bar].

### Below-bar / deprecations:
- June 30, 2026 — Agent Platform Workbench Python 3.12 base containers [runtime bump].
- Gemini 3.1 Flash Image Preview / 3 Pro Image Preview deprecated (migrate before Jul 17, 2026) [DEPRECATION].
- Vertex AI Extensions deprecated, shutdown Nov 26, 2026 [DEPRECATION].

Updated: 2026-07-08 — Secondary tier. REPORTING net-new GA governance/security surfaces:
Security dashboard/posture findings, Model Armor on Agent Gateway, Agent Observability.
